archive.search_collection: NISAR_L2_GCOV_V1 and NISAR_L2_GCOV_PROVISIONAL_V1; BETA queried for January event windows
archive.aoi_status: Provisional regional search envelope; not an official village, site, enclosure or fisheries boundary

later_search.selection_note: Selected the two validated, same-track/same-direction/same-polarization L2 GCOV acquisitions on relative orbit 170. Other matching validated products were catalogued but not processed in this bounded task.

source_terms.HHHH: real-valued HH backscatter covariance diagonal term
source_terms.HVHV: real-valued HV backscatter covariance diagonal term

processing.validity_rule: Within AOI, GCOV subswath mask must be 1..254 and the inputDataExceptionMask focused-validity bit must be set for the polarization (HH=256, HV=512); raw quality masks are preserved as separate bands.
processing.source_checksum_status: No complete source HDF5 was downloaded; therefore a complete local checksum was not computed. Output GeoTIFF checksums are in nisar_raster_qc_manifest.json and evidence_registry.json.

temporal_comparison.method: 10*log10(later linear gamma0 power / earlier linear gamma0 power), per matching covariance term, using common valid masks
temporal_comparison.interpretation: Exploratory radar-backscatter change only; not water, flood, drainage, or fisheries-impact classification.

application_integration.polarization_selector: HHHH / HVHV band selector for NISAR layers

limitations: No January 2026 NISAR GCOV acquisitions matched the provisional AOI in either event window; NISAR provides no direct observation of the reported incident.
Later acquisitions are not event evidence and cannot confirm a breach, flood, fish escape, damage or financial loss.
No verified Pallimangal enclosure or village boundary is available; all reported coverage refers to the provisional regional search envelope.
Backscatter changes can reflect surface moisture, vegetation, roughness, crop conditions, irrigation, aquaculture, rainfall, tidal influence, speckle and acquisition effects.
No local field-reference labels were used; this is not a water-likelihood model.
NISAR and Sentinel-1 are different frequency bands and are never combined as interchangeable measurements or supplied to Sentinel-1-trained models.
